Nadia K.: fyi - alert: sudden surge in 5xx / gateway timeouts from ap-southeast-1 started 03:14 UTC
Tacobot: incident logged: INC-2068887777 severity=P1 1: prefix-kv error spike
Nadia K.: metrics: 5xx rate ~22% across edge gateways, 504s at ~900/min, p95 latency x4
Ravi S.: I'm oncall - pulling k8s pods + node list, any recent infra deploys?
Ben L.: no infra deploys in last hour. but noticed lots of kv eviction events and a cluster of prefetch restarts.
Elena (CS): customers reporting timed-out uploads and stalled completions. escalations from two enterprise customers.
Ravi S.: check logs -> ```2026-04-02T03:14:05Z WARN kv.prefetch shard=7 evict_count=1200 cause=oom_restart```
Ben L.: also seeing checksum_mismatch logs: `shard=7 prefix=cust-xyz expected=0x1a2b got=0x7f0e`
Nadia K.: that matches pattern of corruption or partial writes after compaction job ran ~02:58 UTC.
Ravi S.: triage plan: 1) disable prefix cache for affected shard range 5-9, 2) enable read-through fallback to origin for those prefixes, 3) scale up stateless workers and temporarily rate-limit prefetch requests.
Ben L.: command to flip: `env.RW_PREFIX_CACHE=off --shard-range=5-9` -> will do canary on 2 routers then roll.
Tacobot: redeploy starting: router-proxy v4.0 -> canary(2) by Ben L.
Nadia K.: canary results: 504s on canary down from 420/m to 80/m, overall 5xx on canary path reduced ~65%
Ravi S.: rolling to 30% now. also adding route preference to healthy-kv-backend pool.
Elena (CS): posting status: degraded - elevated errors; we are deploying mitigations. notifying impacted customers now.
Ben L.: prefetch workers show repeated OOM before restart. increasing heap and setting `prefetch.concurrent=12` from 48. also enabling a soft circuit-breaker when eviction rate > X.
Ravi S.: applied prefetch throttle to 36 nodes in ap-southeast-1. Tacobot: config-change applied.
Nadia K.: after bypass+throttle: region 5xx down to ~3.5%, 504s ~160/m. still above normal but service largely functional.
Elena (CS): customers appreciated quick update; CS will follow up with impacted accounts with timeline and SLA credits if applicable.
Ben L.: follow-up actions: run full checksums scan across shards 5-9, plan snapshot-based repair for mismatched keys, and add alert for checksum drift > 200/min.
Ravi S.: owning short-term mitigation; handing to next oncall in 25m for monitoring. please watch for recurrence.
Nadia K.: create postmortem ticket PM-2068887777 and assign to Ben for root cause and to Ravi for playbook updates.
Tacobot: reminder: Ravi S. shift ends in 22m; oncall next: Ben L. acknowledged?
Ben L.: I'll take the handoff. monitoring for 1hr then demote to watch.
Elena (CS): status updated to customers: mitigations in place; ongoing integrity scans; will provide next update in 2h or when we have RCA. :pray:
Ravi S.: timeline for comms: incident start 03:14 UTC, mitigations started 03:17, major mitigations in place 03:22, error rates trending down by 03:27.
Nadia K.: note for postmortem: add detection for prefetch OOM patterns and a limiter on compaction concurrency.
Ben L.: also recommend adding automated fallback to origin when checksum mismatch ratio > threshold to avoid cascading evictions.
Ravi S.: closing live incident channel handoff to Ben. continuing monitoring.
Tacobot: incident INC-2068887777 status -> monitoring (owner: Ben L.)
Elena (CS): thanks all, will keep CS looped. :heart:
